name: 26 Metals Inc.
summary: 26 Metals Inc. engages in the exploration company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral resource properties. The company explores for iron ore. its flagship project is Florália Hematite Iron Ore Project covers approximately 613 hectares located 70km east of Belo Horizonte in Minas Gerais, Florália. The company was formerly known as Bolt Metals Corp. and changed its name to 26 Metals Inc. in August 2026. 26 Metals Inc. is based in West Vancouver, Canada.
